Describe the trigger and resulting behavior.

Evidence classification: confirmed live / reproduced from a captured response / synthetic edge case / repository-only change.

Reproduction: name the capture or synthetic test and say whether the failing path ran. For live evidence, include the environment and observation time. Link any existing report that supports the claim.

Missing evidence: state what remains unverified. Describe synthetic-only playback fixes as preventive hardening.

Validation: record the pre-fix revision, regression test, expected failure, and passing result after the fix. Include the checks run and any skips.
